title: Signed line module action presentations
statement: Let U:C→D be continuous and its set inverse image preserve finite limits. Given a unit presentation [def-pur-signed-line-pullback-unit-presentation] of S by R whose unit is a:R→U_*S, and an isomorphism presenting the underlying set of the abelian inverse image compatibly with its unit, there is an InverseImageAction(a,M) [def-pur-signed-line-module-inverse-image-action] on that abelian inverse image. The action is obtained by transporting scalar multiplication along inverse image and the given presentations; its module axioms and restriction semilinearity hold globally.

source.place: Tags 03D2, 03D3, 03EL and 0FNY; for derived localization use derived.tex Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 015F. Specialization of the Powers and duals paragraph of the current blueprint.

proof.text: Transport multiplication using the binary product presentation. Naturality and the unit equations identify its value on source unit sections. Verify additivity in each argument, associativity, and the scalar unit by hom_ext on inverse images of products. Semilinearity under restriction follows from naturality of the transported multiplication. The source scalar-action graph gives the required semilinear adjunction unit.

theorem inverseImageAction_of_presentations
    (pr : SheafPullbackUnitPresentation (F := F)
      ((sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat.{max u v w})).obj A)
      ((sheafCompose K (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat.{max u v w})).obj B))
    (hr : pr.unit = (sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat.{max u v w})).map φ)
    (pa : SheafPullbackUnitPresentation (F := F)
      ((sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w})).obj ((toSheaf A).obj M))
      ((sheafCompose K (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w})).obj
        ((sheafPullback F AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w} J K).obj ((toSheaf A).obj M))))
    (ha : pa.unit = (sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w})).map
      ((sheafAdjunctionContinuous F AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w} J K).unit.app ((toSheaf A).obj M))) :
    Nonempty (InverseImageAction φ M)
